findings.fsdQuote: Up to 10 series can be selected from the search results and added together in one step.
findings.note: Each search result is added one at a time through its own modal; there is no multi-select add.

findings.fsdQuote: The episode list of a series can be exported as a CSV file.
findings.note: The series details toolbar has no CSV export.

findings.fsdQuote: Deleting a series always deletes its folder and all its files from disk.
findings.note: Delete modal has an optional Delete Files checkbox, off by default.

findings.fsdQuote: Episodes can be dragged to another day to change their air date.
findings.note: Calendar has no drag and drop of episodes.

findings.fsdQuote: Sonarr can share the calendar as an iCal feed, which covers the previous 14 days and the next 60 days.
findings.note: iCal feed defaults to 7 past days and 28 future days.

findings.fsdQuote: The queue is not stored by Sonarr: it is read from the download clients.
findings.note: Queue also includes pending releases that Sonarr stores itself.

findings.fsdQuote: The user can remove a release from the queue. Removing an item from the queue always adds the release to the blocklist.
findings.note: Removal modal offers Do Not Blocklist, Blocklist and Search, or Blocklist Only.

findings.fsdQuote: Each queue item has a priority (High, Normal or Low) that the user can change to reorder the downloads.
findings.note: The queue screen has no priority control.

findings.fsdQuote: Any history entry can be undone, which restores the episode file that an upgrade replaced.
findings.note: History only offers Mark as Failed on details; no undo.

findings.fsdQuote: The user can search for the selected episodes, or for all missing episodes. Search All starts straight away, without asking the user to confirm.
findings.note: Search for all missing episodes opens a confirmation modal first.

findings.fsdQuote: A weekly email digest lists every missing episode.
findings.note: No digest exists; email is only a notification connection.

findings.fsdQuote: Tag labels may contain letters, numbers, spaces and underscores.
findings.note: Validator allows only letters, numbers and hyphen; no spaces or underscores.

findings.fsdQuote: Deleting a tag removes it from every series, profile and indexer that uses it.
findings.note: A tag that is in use cannot be deleted.

findings.fsdQuote: Each tag has a colour, chosen from a palette of 12 colours, which is shown wherever the tag appears.
findings.note: Tags have only a label; no colour.

findings.fsdQuote: The default delay profile can be given tags like any other.
findings.note: Default profile (id 1) must have no tags.

findings.fsdQuote: Each quality can be limited to a maximum episode runtime.
findings.note: Only size limits are offered; no runtime limit.

findings.fsdQuote: Each log file can grow up to 50 megabytes before a new one is started.
findings.note: Log size limit is validated between 1 and 10 MB.

findings.fsdQuote: Interval: how often an automatic backup is taken, from 1 to 30 days.
findings.note: Interval is limited to 1 to 7 days.

findings.fsdQuote: Retention: how long backups are kept, up to 365 days.
findings.note: Retention is limited to 1 to 90 days.

findings.fsdQuote: The font size can be set to small, medium or large.
findings.note: No font size option on the UI settings screen.

findings.fsdQuote: Backups can be copied automatically to an S3 bucket.
findings.note: No S3 backup option exists.
